current_role: Deputy Secretary of Veterans Affairs (since March 2025)
summary: Paul Lawrence, an Army veteran who was VA under secretary for benefits in Trump’s first term, was confirmed 51–45 in March 2025 as Doug Collins’s deputy and leads the rollout of VA’s new electronic health record.
